state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing game (web now, a real mobile app later), built 100% by AI. Today only the owner and one child play.
state.owner_requirement: The game is for all ages: children and adults both play and learn. It is an online game like Minecraft. It is not only for children, so it does not require parental supervision; parents are responsible for their children playing.
facts: Account model today: a Google sign-in owner account (called 'parent'), up to 3 child profiles picked from a fixed display-name list, a parent area to create/rename/delete profiles, download data and delete the account, and a consent policy (version v2) accepted before profiles can be made.
Just shipped: the parent PIN is now optional. With no PIN the parent area is always open; a PIN can be set later from the parent area. A fresh Google sign-in now goes straight to the consent screen.

Review found: the parent area still says 'Two steps: create a profile, then lock this area and hand the device to the child' and its button reads 'Done, lock the parent area', but with no PIN locking does nothing.
Review found: the sign-in title is 'Parent sign-in' and the consent button is 'I am a parent and I agree', which excludes adults who play for themselves.

Review found: the privacy policy says deleting a profile or the account 'needs the parent PIN', and the consent text says the PIN is stored; both are now only true when a PIN was set. Changing consent text requires bumping the policy version, which makes every account accept again; the privacy page can change without re-consent.
Review found: once set, a PIN can never be changed or removed (only a fresh Google re-login bypasses it), so 'optional' is one-way.

Removing child profiles entirely (one player per account, adults sign in for themselves) needs a database migration of every game table keyed by profile id, a rewrite of the profile picker, and new handling for children under the age Google allows; it is a large change.
A stale review screenshot of the removed set-PIN step is still in the generated review assets and manifest.

lock_wording.instructions: How should the parent area's 'lock this area and hand over the device' step read now that the PIN is optional?

criteria.adapt_to_pin: Show lock wording only when a PIN is set; without a PIN the step says 'Done, go play' and just returns to the profile picker.
criteria.keep_as_is: Leave the current lock wording for every account.

audience_wording.instructions: Should the sign-in title, consent button and similar 'parent' wording on shared screens be changed for an all-ages audience?

criteria.neutral_now: Change now to neutral wording ('Sign in', 'I agree', 'account owner area'), adding a line that a parent who lets a child play is responsible for them.
criteria.keep_parent: Keep the parent wording until the account model itself changes.

legal_text.instructions: How should the consent and privacy texts be brought in line with the optional PIN and the all-ages, parents-responsible requirement?

criteria.privacy_now_consent_later: Fix the privacy page now (PIN only if set; parents responsible); leave the consent text at v2 and bundle its change with the next account-model change so players accept only once.
criteria.both_now_bump_v3: Rewrite both now and bump consent to v3, so every account re-accepts immediately.
criteria.defer_all: Change neither until a lawyer reviews.

pin_management.instructions: Should the account owner be able to change or remove the optional PIN?

criteria.add_now: Add change/remove PIN in the parent area now, allowed only while the area is unlocked.
criteria.defer: Leave it; a fresh Google re-login already bypasses a forgotten PIN.

account_model.instructions: What should happen next with the account model for an all-ages online game with a mobile app later?

criteria.plan_single_player: Write a plan now to move to one player per signed-in account (profiles become optional extra players on a shared device), to be built after the plan is reviewed.
criteria.keep_profiles: Keep the owner account with up to 3 player profiles as the long-term model, only renaming 'child profile' to 'player'.
criteria.defer: Do nothing until multiplayer or the mobile app work starts.

stale_screenshot.instructions: What to do with the stale set-PIN review screenshot?

criteria.remove_now: Delete it and regenerate the asset manifest now.
criteria.leave: Leave it until the next E2E run regenerates review shots.
